rows.title: Space trivia post
rows.text: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye. Light from the Sun takes about eight minutes to reach Earth. A day on Venus is longer than its year.
rows.summary: Two of three claims hold. The Great Wall claim is a common myth.

rows.title: Health newsletter
rows.text: People use only ten percent of their brains. An adult human body has 206 bones. Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
rows.summary: One of three claims holds. The other two are popular myths.

rows.title: Geography quiz
rows.text: Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level. The Sahara is the largest desert on Earth. Russia spans eleven time zones.
rows.summary: Two of three claims hold. The largest desert is Antarctica. The Sahara is the largest hot desert.

rows.title: Science class handout
rows.text: Humans have exactly five senses. Sound travels faster in water than in air. The Moon has no gravity.

rows.statement: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye
rows.reason: Astronauts report that the wall cannot be picked out with the unaided eye from orbit. It is long but narrow.

rows.statement: Light from the Sun takes about eight minutes to reach Earth
rows.reason: Light covers the average distance between the Sun and Earth in a little over eight minutes.

rows.statement: A day on Venus is longer than its year
rows.reason: Venus turns once in about 243 Earth days and goes round the Sun in about 225.

rows.statement: People use only ten percent of their brains
rows.reason: Brain imaging shows activity across the whole brain. No large region sits unused.

rows.statement: An adult human body has 206 bones
rows.reason: The usual count for an adult skeleton is 206.

rows.statement: Lightning never strikes the same place twice
rows.reason: Tall structures are struck again and again, some of them many times a year.

rows.statement: Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level
rows.reason: Its summit is the highest point on Earth above sea level.

rows.statement: The Sahara is the largest desert on Earth
rows.reason: A desert is defined by low rainfall, which makes Antarctica the largest. The Sahara is the largest hot desert.

rows.title: Great Wall of China
rows.finding: The wall is generally not visible to the unaided eye from low Earth orbit.

rows.title: Sunlight
rows.finding: Sunlight takes a little over eight minutes to reach Earth.

rows.title: Venus
rows.finding: Venus rotates more slowly than it orbits the Sun.

rows.title: Ten percent of the brain myth
rows.finding: The idea that people use a tenth of their brain is a myth.

rows.title: Human skeleton
rows.finding: The adult human skeleton has 206 bones.

rows.title: Lightning
rows.finding: Lightning can and does strike the same place more than once.

rows.title: Mount Everest
rows.finding: Everest is the highest mountain above sea level.

rows.title: Desert
rows.finding: The largest deserts are polar. The Sahara is the largest hot desert.

rows.title: Science class handout
rows.text: Humans have exactly five senses. Sound travels faster in water than in air. The Moon has no gravity.

rows.statement: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye
rows.reason: Astronauts report that the wall cannot be picked out with the unaided eye from orbit. It is long but narrow.

rows.statement: Light from the Sun takes about eight minutes to reach Earth
rows.reason: Light covers the average distance between the Sun and Earth in a little over eight minutes.

rows.statement: A day on Venus is longer than its year
rows.reason: Venus turns once in about 243 Earth days and goes round the Sun in about 225.

rows.statement: People use only ten percent of their brains
rows.reason: Brain imaging shows activity across the whole brain. No large region sits unused.

rows.statement: An adult human body has 206 bones
rows.reason: The usual count for an adult skeleton is 206.

rows.statement: Lightning never strikes the same place twice
rows.reason: Tall structures are struck again and again, some of them many times a year.

rows.statement: Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level
rows.reason: Its summit is the highest point on Earth above sea level.

rows.statement: The Sahara is the largest desert on Earth
rows.reason: A desert is defined by low rainfall, which makes Antarctica the largest. The Sahara is the largest hot desert.

team.title: Fact-check team

agents.name: Verifier
agents.job: Weighs the evidence, gives every claim a verdict with a confidence from 0 to 100, and sums up the text. Thin evidence means unverifiable, not a guess.

rows.motion: Rewrite the billing service instead of refactoring it
rows.context: The service is eight years old, has few tests, and every change takes weeks.
rows.summary: Refactor behind tests first. Look at a rewrite again only if the data model blocks the next two features.

rows.motion: Replace the weekly status meeting with a written update
rows.context: The meeting takes an hour for twelve people and most of it is read-outs.
rows.summary: Try written updates for a month and keep a short call for blockers.

rows.motion: Use TypeScript for all new front-end work
rows.context: Half the team knows it well. The other half has never used it.
rows.summary: No clear lean. Parked until the design system work is finished.

rows.motion: Start with one codebase before splitting into services
rows.context: We are six engineers building a new scheduling product. Two of us want separate services from day one.

team.title: Debate team
team.about: Two agents argue one motion from opposite sides and a third sums up. You can add a point of your own before the summary.

agents.name: For
agents.job: Makes the strongest honest case for the motion, in three points.

agents.name: Against
agents.job: Makes the strongest honest case against the motion and answers the points made for it.
agents.hint: Set "reply_to" to the number of the point you are answering.

agents.name: Moderator
agents.job: Weighs both sides and anything added from the floor, then records what is agreed, what is open, the risks and one recommendation.

pause.text: Both sides have spoken. Add a point of your own before the Moderator sums up, or continue.
